board.name: Tamil Nadu State Board of School Education

textbook.title: Standard Ten English
textbook.publisher: Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation

checklist_items.label: Read 'His First Flight' text
checklist_items.description: Read the story of the young seagull overcoming fear to fly.

checklist_items.label: In-text Comprehension Questions (a - g)
checklist_items.description: Answer questions on the seagull's siblings, parents, first catch, and fear.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary & Key Words
checklist_items.description: Learn meanings of ledge, shrilly, herring, devour, cackle, mackerel, whet, preening, plaintively, swoop, monstrous.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 sentences (Questions 1 to 6)
checklist_items.description: Short answer questions on young seagull's struggles, parents' coaxing, and first flight.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions (Questions 1 & 2)
checklist_items.description: Detailed paragraph responses on overcoming fear and parental discipline.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Parts of Speech (Sets 1 & 2)
checklist_items.description: Identify adjectives, nouns, and adverbs derived from story words.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary D: Change Form of Underlined Words
checklist_items.description: Convert word forms into adjectives, adverbs, nouns, and verbs.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary E: Construct Sentences
checklist_items.description: Make sentences with coward, gradual, praise, courageous, starvation.

checklist_items.label: Listening Activity F: Travelogue Comprehension
checklist_items.description: Listen to travelogue excerpt and answer related questions.

checklist_items.label: Speaking Activity G: Dialogue Continuation
checklist_items.description: Continue Mary and Father dialogue planning a trip to the forest.

checklist_items.label: Reading Comprehension H: Bungee Jumping Passage
checklist_items.description: Read adventure travel passage and answer questions 1 to 6.

checklist_items.label: Writing Activity I: Prepare Advertisements
checklist_items.description: Draft attractive commercial ads using provided hints for Home appliances & Mobile Galaxy.

checklist_items.label: Writing Activity J: Report Writing
checklist_items.description: Write 100-120 word reports on Educational Development Day or Literary Association.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Modals & Semi-Modals (Exercises A - E)
checklist_items.description: Practice modal verbs (can, could, may, might, must, should, would) in dialogues and sentences.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Active and Passive Voice (Exercises F - K)
checklist_items.description: Convert active voice into passive voice, commands, requests, recipes, and event reports.

checklist_items.label: Revise His First Flight & Grammar Concepts
checklist_items.description: Comprehensive revision of questions, vocabulary, modals, and voice.

checklist_items.label: Recite & Memorise 'Life' Poem
checklist_items.description: Memorise the 14-line sonnet with forward face and unreluctant soul.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn meanings of mourning, veils, crown, quest, unreluctant.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions (1 to 5)
checklist_items.description: Rhyme scheme, poetic devices, and analytical questions on stanzas.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Write an 80-100 word essay describing the poet's positive journey through life.

checklist_items.label: Poem Activity C: Complete Summary Passage
checklist_items.description: Fill in the missing keywords to complete the poem summary.

checklist_items.label: Read & Enjoy: 'Sea Fever' by John Masefield
checklist_items.description: Appreciation of adventurous seafaring poetry.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Tempest' Tale
checklist_items.description: Read the story of Prospero, Miranda, Ariel, Caliban, and Ferdinand on the enchanted island.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn tormenting, dreadful, duke, deprive, familiar.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Choose the Correct Answer
checklist_items.description: Multiple-choice comprehension questions on the plot and characters.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Identify the Character or Speaker
checklist_items.description: Recognize character quotes from Prospero, Miranda, Ferdinand, and Ariel.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Brief questions about Prospero's magical spells, brother's betrayal, and forgiveness.

checklist_items.label: Exercise D: Rearrange the Jumbled Sentences
checklist_items.description: Put the story events into correct chronological sequence.

checklist_items.label: Exercise E: Paragraph Questions (1 & 2)
checklist_items.description: Character sketches and thematic analysis of forgiveness and reconciliation.

lessons.title: The Night the Ghost Got In
lessons.author: James Thurber

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Night the Ghost Got In'
checklist_items.description: Read James Thurber's comic memoir of midnight chaos and mistaken burglars.

checklist_items.label: In-text Comprehension Questions (a - g)
checklist_items.description: Questions on strange sounds, grandfather's behaviour, and mother's shoe throwing.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn hullabaloo, bevelled, hysterical, creaking, indignant.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Short answer questions on the misunderstanding between police, grandfather, and narrator.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Describe the humorous sequence of events that unfolded in the house.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Slang & Informal Expressions (A - D)
checklist_items.description: Explore colloquial words, idioms, and figurative usage.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking Activities (E - G)
checklist_items.description: Listening comprehension and humorous storytelling practice.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Notice Writing & Message Writing
checklist_items.description: Format and compose school notices and telephone messages.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Articles & Determiners (Exercises A - E)
checklist_items.description: Definite and indefinite articles, quantifiers, demonstratives, and possessives.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Prepositions & Prepositional Phrases (F - I)
checklist_items.description: Prepositions of time, place, direction, and phrasal prepositions.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 2 Grammar & Vocabulary
checklist_items.description: Review articles, prepositions, notices, and story themes.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Grumble Family'
checklist_items.description: Read about Complaining Street, River of Discontent, and avoiding chronic grumbling.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn discontent, amiss, growl, grumble, gloom.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Questions analyzing the satirical portrayal of chronic fault-finders.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Discuss the moral lesson of staying cheerful and avoiding the Grumble family's habits.

checklist_items.label: Poem Activities & Appreciation
checklist_items.description: Rhyme scheme and figures of speech (personification, hyperbole).

checklist_items.label: Read 'Zigzag' Tale
checklist_items.description: Enjoy the tale of Dr. Krishnan's family and the peculiar multi-lingual African bird.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn commotion, eavesdrop, squawk, snoring, pandemonium.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Identify Speaker or Character
checklist_items.description: Who said what to whom in the clinic and household.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Multiple-Choice & Sequencing
checklist_items.description: Test comprehension of Zigzag's snoring and surprise transformation in the clinic.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Questions on how Zigzag changed from a nuisance into a clinic helper.

checklist_items.label: Exercise D: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Write a summary of the chaos caused by Zigzag and Mrs. Krishnan's ruined painting.

checklist_items.label: Read 'Empowered Women Navigating the World'
checklist_items.description: Learn about the all-woman Indian Navy crew circum-navigating the globe in INSV Tarini.

checklist_items.label: In-text Questions (a - j)
checklist_items.description: Questions on INSV Tarini, training of the six officers, challenges, and team bonding.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn auxiliary, indigenous, circumnavigation, skipper, appraisal.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Short answers on Lt Cdr Vartika Joshi and the crew's achievements.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Paragraph responses highlighting grit, resilience, and women empowerment.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Nautical Terms (A - E)
checklist_items.description: Idioms related to water, sea journeys, and phrasal verbs.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking Activities (F - I)
checklist_items.description: Interview simulation and maritime weather reports.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Formal Letter & Email Writing
checklist_items.description: Write letters of complaint, appreciation, and professional emails.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Tenses (Present, Past, Future) (Exercises A - G)
checklist_items.description: Master simple, continuous, perfect, and perfect continuous tense structures.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Subject-Verb Agreement (Concord) (H - J)
checklist_items.description: Rules of concord with singular/plural subjects and collective nouns.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 3 Tenses & Concord
checklist_items.description: Review tense timeline rules and subject-verb concord rules.

checklist_items.label: Recite & Memorise 'I am Every Woman'
checklist_items.description: Memorise the inspirational poem celebrating the strength, dignity, and tenacity of modern women.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn innate, stake, persistence, prank, ferocious.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Analyze tone, metaphors (lioness), and questions on each stanza.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Discuss how women face challenges today without fear or compromise.

checklist_items.label: Poem Activities & Appreciation
checklist_items.description: Figures of speech: Metaphor, Alliteration, Rhyme.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Story of Mulan'
checklist_items.description: Read the heroic legend of Hua Mulan disguising as a man to save her aging father.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn carve, robe, general, soldier, emperor.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Choose the Best Option
checklist_items.description: Comprehension checks on why Mulan joined the army and how she saved China.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Identify the Speaker
checklist_items.description: Match quotes with Mulan, Emperor, and Father.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Questions on Mulan's military battles and reward rejection.

checklist_items.label: Exercise D: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Evaluate Mulan's patriotism, filial piety, and courage in detail.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Attic'
checklist_items.description: Satyajit Ray's touching story of Aditya visiting his ancestral home to right an old wrong.

checklist_items.label: In-text Questions (a - h)
checklist_items.description: Questions on the tea shop, Sasanka Sanyal, the silver medal, and the attic visit.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn bifurcated, revive, soothing, rustic, vent.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Short answer questions on Sanyal's recitation of Tagore's poem and Aditya's regret.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Paragraph responses on restitution, conscience, and childhood friendship.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Affixes, Prefixes & Suffixes (A - D)
checklist_items.description: Word building using prefixes and suffixes to form nouns and adjectives.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking: Audio & Roleplay (E - G)
checklist_items.description: Listening to audio story and enacting scenes between Aditya and Sanyal.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Article Writing & Speech Writing
checklist_items.description: Structure articles for school magazines and formal school assembly speeches.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Connectors & Linkers (Exercises A - D)
checklist_items.description: Coordinating, subordinating, and correlative conjunctions.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Nominalisation (E - G)
checklist_items.description: Transforming verbs and adjectives into formal abstract nouns.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 4 Connectors & Word Forms
checklist_items.description: Review connectors, linkers, nominalisation, and comprehension.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Ant and the Cricket'
checklist_items.description: Read the timeless fable on the importance of diligence, forethought, and hard work.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn accustom, famine, miserly, quoth, warrant.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Rhyme scheme, character contrasts between ant and cricket.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Explain the fable's moral: 'Work hard today to enjoy tomorrow.'

checklist_items.label: Poem Appreciation & Parallel Reading
checklist_items.description: Compare with contemporary stories of thrift and planning.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Aged Mother'
checklist_items.description: A Japanese folk tale illustrating the wisdom of elders in saving a province.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn despotic, mandate, summit, twilight, ashes.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Match & True/False
checklist_items.description: Identify the tyrannical governor's decree and the son's devotion.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Questions on the rope of ashes and the mother's twigs dropped on the trail.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Discuss the theme: 'With the crown of snow, there cometh wisdom.'

checklist_items.label: Read 'Tech Bloomers'
checklist_items.description: Discover how assistive technology empowers differently-abled individuals like Alisha and David.

checklist_items.label: In-text Questions (a - g)
checklist_items.description: Questions on dragon dictate, eye gaze technology, and assistive communication.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn debilitating, inclusions, impaired, prodigy, AAC.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: How technology broke barriers for differently-abled students.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Detailed account of Kim's Assistive Technology research and real-life impact.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Compound Words & Tech Acronyms (A - E)
checklist_items.description: Compound nouns, abbreviations, acronyms, and tech terminology.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking: Tech Debates (F - H)
checklist_items.description: Speaking debate on artificial intelligence and assistive technology.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Process Description & Formal Emails
checklist_items.description: Writing step-by-step instructions and technical explanations.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Pronouns (Personal, Relative, Demonstrative) (A - D)
checklist_items.description: Relative clauses (who, which, that, whom, whose) and antecedents.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Reported Speech (Direct to Indirect) (E - I)
checklist_items.description: Rules for statements, questions, imperatives, and exclamations.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 5 Reported Speech & Relative Clauses
checklist_items.description: Review reported speech transformation rules and exercises.

checklist_items.label: Recite & Memorise 'The Secret of the Machines'
checklist_items.description: Memorise Kipling's powerful poem on the power and limitations of industrial machines.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn ore-bed, furnace, wrought, gauged, monster.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Questions analyzing machine capabilities vs lack of human feelings and morality.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Explain why machines are 'nothing more than children of your brain.'

checklist_items.label: Poem Appreciation: Rhyme & Imagery
checklist_items.description: Hyperbole, personification, and mechanical rhythm.

lessons.title: A day in 2889 of an American Journalist
lessons.author: Jules Verne

checklist_items.label: Read 'A day in 2889 of an American Journalist'
checklist_items.description: Jules Verne's visionary sci-fi story of Earth Chronicle editor Fritz Napoleon Smith in the year 2889.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn telephote, phonotelephote, aero-car, incubator, subterranean.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Identify Speaker & True/False
checklist_items.description: Distinguish futuristic inventions predicted by Jules Verne.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Questions on advertisements projected on clouds and fast tube travel.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Analyze Verne's uncanny predictions that have become reality today.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Last Lesson'
checklist_items.description: Read Franz's awakening to the value of his native mother tongue in Alsace-Lorraine.

checklist_items.label: In-text Questions (a - g)
checklist_items.description: Questions on M. Hamel's green coat, villagers sitting on back benches, and the Prussian order.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn dread, commotion, gravely, reproach, vivat.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Why was Franz afraid of being questioned on participles?

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: M. Hamel's tribute to the French language as the most beautiful, clear, and logical key to freedom.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Foreign Words & Expressions (A - D)
checklist_items.description: Latin and French loan words commonly used in English.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking: Patriotic Speeches
checklist_items.description: Deliver a speech on linguistic diversity and mother tongue pride.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Poster Making & Slogan Writing
checklist_items.description: Design informative and eye-catching posters with catchy slogans.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Simple, Compound, and Complex Sentences (A - E)
checklist_items.description: Main clauses, subordinate clauses, and transformation of sentence types.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 6 Clause Transformation
checklist_items.description: Review simple, compound, and complex sentence transformations.

checklist_items.label: Recite & Memorise 'No Men Are Foreign'
checklist_items.description: Memorise the universal humanitarian poem condemning warfare and preaching world peace.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn dispossess, betray, condemn, defile, outrage.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Common human anatomy, harvests, and shared earth across countries.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: How does Kirkup prove that all human beings are brothers under the sun?

checklist_items.label: Poem Activities & Appreciation
checklist_items.description: Universal brotherhood reflections and poetic devices.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Little Hero of Holland'
checklist_items.description: The courageous tale of 8-year-old Peter holding back the North Sea leak with his finger through the night.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn dike, trickle, sluice, numb, vigil.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Match & True/False
checklist_items.description: Check key milestones of Peter's vigil at the dike.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Peter's sense of duty to his town and parents.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Narrate Peter's determination and how his alertness saved Holland from inundation.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The Dying Detective'
checklist_items.description: Sherlock Holmes' theatrical ruse to entrap Culverton Smith for Victor Savage's murder.

checklist_items.label: In-text Questions (a - g)
checklist_items.description: Questions on Holmes' fake fever, Dr. Watson's concern, and the ivory box.

checklist_items.label: Study Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn delirious, gaunt, listless, ruse, vindictive.

checklist_items.label: Comprehension A: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Why did Holmes forbid Watson from examining him or touching his things?

checklist_items.label: Comprehension B: Paragraph Questions
checklist_items.description: Explain how Holmes outwitted Culverton Smith with the help of Inspector Morton.

checklist_items.label: Vocabulary: Homophones, Confusables & British/American English (A - E)
checklist_items.description: Distinguish tricky word pairs and American vs British spellings.

checklist_items.label: Listening & Speaking: Detective Clues & Interrogation
checklist_items.description: Simulate deductive reasoning dialogue and mystery clues.

checklist_items.label: Writing: Pamphlet Making & Story Writing
checklist_items.description: Creating awareness pamphlets and continuing mystery stories.

checklist_items.label: Grammar: Degrees of Comparison (A - E)
checklist_items.description: Positive, Comparative, and Superlative degree transformations.

checklist_items.label: Revise Unit 7 Degrees of Comparison
checklist_items.description: Review degrees of comparison rules and mystery story elements.

checklist_items.label: Read 'The House on Elm Street'
checklist_items.description: Atmospheric poem capturing the suspense and ghostly rumors of an abandoned house.

checklist_items.label: Study Poem Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn dread, eerie, bare, fade, mystery.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension A: Stanza Questions
checklist_items.description: Poetic devices, imagery of the house that remains a mystery.

checklist_items.label: Poem Comprehension B: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Describe the eerie atmosphere and supernatural aura created by the poet.

checklist_items.label: Read 'A Dilemma'
checklist_items.description: Uncle Philip's iron box bequest stuffed with priceless gems and dynamite trigger.

checklist_items.label: Study Supplementary Glossary
checklist_items.description: Learn eccentricity, malice, bequeath, contrivance, dilemma.

checklist_items.label: Exercise A: Match & True/False
checklist_items.description: Comprehension check on Tom's inheritance and the warning letter.

checklist_items.label: Exercise B: Answer in 1-2 Sentences
checklist_items.description: Tom's sleepless attempts, consultations with professors and dynamiters.

checklist_items.label: Exercise C: Paragraph Question
checklist_items.description: Detail Tom's psychological torment and his final bequest to the Smithsonian Institute.
